login.title: Welcome back

new.name: Child's name

new.subtitleCompanion: For a child already diagnosed or being assessed. Next, you'll add the diagnosis details.

home.heroBody: A few questions and short games give you a picture of your child's development. It is not a diagnosis, and it takes about 15 minutes.

details.title: Tell us a little about your child
details.subtitle: We need this to match the questions and the result to your child's age.
details.anotherChildHint: Add their name and date of birth
details.informantHint: The person who spends the most time with the child.
details.ageYounger: This screening was made for children aged 16 months to 4 years. You can still do it, but for a child this young the result is less certain.
details.ageOlder: This screening was made for children aged 16 months to 4 years. You can still do it, but for an older child the result is less certain.
details.ageBlockedTitle: This screening isn't made for this age
details.ageBlockedYoung: It can be done from 12 months. If anything worries you now, please talk to a child doctor. You don't need to wait.
details.ageBlockedOld: It can be done up to 6 years. If anything worries you, a child doctor or a child development specialist can help.
details.openBody: Your answers are saved. {answered, number} of {total, number} questions answered.
details.restartBody: The unfinished screening and all its answers will be deleted.
details.childRequired: Choose who the screening is for.

consent.title: Four things before we start

notDiagnosis.title: This is not a diagnosis
notDiagnosis.body: It helps you understand what to do next. Only a specialist can make a diagnosis.

onDevice.title: Camera and microphone stay on this device
onDevice.body: Video and sound are never uploaded or saved. Only measurements are kept: numbers like "turned their head after 1.2 seconds".

delete.title: Delete it any time
delete.body: Your answers, the measurements and the report can all be deleted whenever you want.

sharing.title: You decide who sees the report
sharing.body: Only people you allow can see it, like a doctor you have added to your child's care team.

consent.agree: I have read this and I agree

question.noRightAnswer: There's no right or wrong answer. Choose what you have seen.
question.otherField: Write it in your own words
question.otherPlaceholder: e.g. He looks when we play, but not when the TV is on…
question.understood: We understood this as {option}. Is that right?
question.keptInReport: What you wrote will also be in the report.
question.pickUnclear: We couldn't tell which answer fits best. Please choose the closest one.
question.pickUnavailable: We can't read written answers right now. Please choose the closest one.
question.pickHint: What you wrote is saved and will be in the report.

hearing.yes_problem: Yes, and a problem was found

communication.sentences: 2 or more words together, like "more milk"
communication.sounds_gestures: Sounds, pointing, or pulling your hand
communication.little: Seldom tries to tell you anything

note.title: Anything else you've noticed?
note.subtitle: Write anything you'd like a doctor to know. This is optional. It goes into the doctor's report exactly as you write it, and it doesn't change the score.
note.label: Your notes
note.placeholder: e.g. He sleeps very little at night…

activities.title: Next, a few short games
activities.subtitle: You stay beside your child while the camera watches how they play.
activities.partOneDone: Questions done. Your answers are saved.
activities.skipNote: Every game can be skipped. If your child gets tired, stop. You can continue later.
activities.answersOnly: See the result from my answers
activities.answersOnlyNote: Without the games the result rests on your answers alone, so it is less certain.
activities.demoBody: The games will be replayed from a recorded sample session ({profile}). No camera is used, and every report will say “Demo”.
activities.privacy: The camera picture and sound stay on this device and are never sent or recorded. Only measurements (numbers) are sent.

childId.qrHint: A teacher or specialist scans this with their phone. Nobody can see anything until you approve them.
childId.regenerateBody: The old ID will stop working for new requests. People already on the team keep their access, and requests already sent stay open.

careTeam.title: {name}'s care team

careTeam.logsHint: Always on for every team member
careTeam.medicationsClinicalHint: Doctors and therapists always see medicines
careTeam.owner: Owner — can see and change everything
careTeam.removeBody: They lose access straight away. They can ask again later with the Child ID.
careTeam.emptyMembers: No one else yet. Share {name}'s Child ID with their teacher or doctor.
careTeam.activityEmpty: Nothing yet. Every time someone on the team views or changes {name}'s record, it shows here.

activity.request: {actor} asked to join the care team

access.requestHint: Ask the parent for their child's Shohojatri ID. They'll see your name, your school or clinic, and your message.

access.sent: If this ID is right, the parent has been told. The child will appear here once they approve.

qrLanding.title: This QR code is for teachers and specialists

kinds.access_request_approved: The parent approved your request — you can now see {child}'s profile
kinds.access_request_declined: The parent declined your request for {code}
kinds.log_digest: {count, number} new notes about {child} today from the care team

specialists.title: Specialists
specialists.subtitle: Doctors and therapists on Shohojatri. Their accounts can only be created here.
specialists.emptyMessage: Add the first specialist — a temporary password will be created for them.

results.title: {name}'s result
results.scoreNote: The score reflects how many early signs we noticed today, not the chance of having autism.

headline.incomplete: Not enough to go on yet

results.support: The earlier support starts, the more children can grow. We're with you at every step.

meaning.low: In this screening we noticed few early signs that need extra attention. Every child grows at their own pace, so keep watching and enjoying how {name} grows.
meaning.moderate: Some of {name}'s responses were a little different from what we usually see at this age. Many children catch up in these areas, but it's good to talk to a doctor.
meaning.elevated: Several of {name}'s responses were different from what many children this age do. A specialist can look more closely and tell you what support would help {name}.
meaning.high: Many of {name}'s responses were different from what children this age usually do. This is not because of anything you did. The sooner a specialist sees {name}, the sooner support can start.
meaning.incomplete: Too many answers were “Not sure”, and no game could be measured, so we can't give a score this time.

results.notDiagnosis: This is not a diagnosis. It helps you decide on the next step.
results.noticedEmpty: Nothing stood out today that needs extra attention.
results.keepPlaying: Keep playing face to face every day: name things, take turns, and enjoy {name}'s smiles.

confidence.title: How sure is this result: {level}

body.low: This result is based mostly on your answers. For a clearer picture, try the activities again in good light.

confidence.lowCoverage: Several questions were answered “Not sure”, which also makes it less certain.

class.low: Keep enjoying everyday play and watching milestones. Screen again in 3–6 months, or any time you are worried.
class.moderate: Talk to a child doctor within about a month and show this report. Screen again in 1–2 months.
class.elevated: We recommend a developmental assessment by a specialist in the next few weeks.
class.high: Please arrange a developmental assessment with a specialist soon. Early support makes a real difference.

recommendations.incomplete: Try the screening again when you can: answer what you've noticed, and do the games in good light.
recommendations.regression: Losing words or skills should be checked by a doctor soon, whatever the score.
recommendations.hearing_test: Get {name}'s hearing checked, so a hearing problem isn't missed.

clinician.title: Developmental screening report

ids.deviceValue: {type, select, phone {Phone} laptop {Laptop/tablet} other {Device}} · {camera, select, front {front camera} rear {rear camera} other {camera}}

clinician.floor: Class raised from {from} to {to} because {rule, select, regression {the parent reported loss of words or skills (q19)} other {3 or more critical items were failed}}.
clinician.regressionFlag: Parent reports loss of words or skills (q19). Please clarify the history.
clinician.mappedBy: {ai, select, true {AI suggested this answer; the parent confirmed it} other {Chosen by the parent}}
clinician.itemsNote: Illustrative item set ({version}), not a validated instrument. “Concern” marks answers scored toward concern. Free-text answers are shown verbatim and were confirmed by the parent.
clinician.activitiesSub: Derived on the device from guided camera activities. No video or audio was stored.

metrics.gaze_preference: Geometric side {geometric}% of tracked gaze · tracked {tracked}% of the time
metrics.free_play: {episodes} repetitive-movement episodes ({arm} arm/hand, {rocking} rocking), {seconds} s in total · vocalising {vocal} s

clinician.methodBody: A {items}-item parent questionnaire is combined with up to five guided camera activities, measured on the parent's device. Weights (renormalised over what was completed): questionnaire {q}%, response to name {rtn}%, joint attention {ja}%, imitation {im}%, look & watch {gp}%, free play {fp}%. Classes: Low ≤ {low} · Moderate ≤ {moderate} · Elevated ≤ {elevated} · High ≤ 100. Floors: loss of skills → at least Moderate; 3+ failed critical items → at least Elevated. Scoring version {version}.
clinician.limits: Heuristic proof of concept: weights, thresholds and items are placeholders, not a validated instrument, with no sensitivity or specificity claims. Not diagnostic. The animated look & watch stimulus is not validated. Lighting, camera angle and the child's mood affect the measurements.
clinician.onlineUntil: Link valid until {date}. The parent can close it at any time.
clinician.noLink: To add a QR code, make a share link from the result page.
clinician.gamesCounted: {games} of {total} activities counted{lowCoverage, select, true {; under 80% of items scorable} other {}}

setup.title: Quick setup check
setup.subtitle: Sit {name} in front of the camera. Start when everything below is green.
setup.twoFaces: Two faces are in view. Tap {name}’s face once.

face.fix: We can’t see {name}’s face well yet

tips.light: Please turn on a light or move near a window.
tips.noFace: Make sure {name}’s face is toward the camera.

device.laptop: A laptop or tablet (on a table)

deviceHint.phone: In the name game you’ll hold the phone with the back camera on your child.
deviceHint.laptop: The device stays on a table, facing your child.

task.errorBody: Try sending again, or play the game again.
task.cameraSwitchFailed: Couldn’t switch the camera. Please try again.

fair.title: Done, but not fully clear
fair.body: The camera didn’t always see {name}, so this game counts with less certainty. You can play it again if you like.

none.title: We couldn’t measure this game
none.body: It won’t count in the score, and never as a concern. Play again if you like, or go on.

skipped.title: Skipped
skipped.body: Skipped games don’t count in the score.

ok.title: Eye check done
ok.body: We can now tell where {name} is looking.

fallback.title: The eye check didn’t fully work
fallback.body: The games still work, but the looking games will be less certain.

skipped.title: Eye check skipped
skipped.body: The looking games will be less certain.

calibration.title: Follow the star
calibration.subtitle: A six-second game so we can tell where on the screen {name} is looking.
calibration.how1: Sit with {name} on your lap, 40–60 cm from the screen (about an arm’s length).
calibration.how2: A star will move across the screen. Ask {name} to watch it.

nameCall.title: Calling their name
nameCall.subtitle: We’ll see whether {name} looks up when you call during play.
nameCall.setupPhone: Hold the phone yourself, back camera on {name}, 1–1.5 m away and a little to the side of where {name} is looking.
nameCall.setupLaptop: Put the device on a table facing {name}, and stand right behind it.
nameCall.setupCall: When the screen says so, say “{name}” once in your normal voice. Don’t wave or touch.
nameCall.watchingHow: Don’t call again — just stay still.
nameCall.wrongNoted: That try won’t count — we’ll do one more.

point.title: Look where I point
point.subtitle: We’ll see whether {name} looks where someone points.
point.variantQuestion: How would you like to play?
point.onScreenHow: A friendly character points at a toy.
point.liveHow: You point at a real toy in the room while the phone watches.
point.onScreenSetup: Sit with {name} on your lap, 40–60 cm from the screen.
point.onScreenParent: During the game, look down at {name}’s head, not the screen, so you don’t give away where to look.
point.liveSetupPhone: Hold the phone in one hand, back camera on {name}. Put a favourite toy about 1 m to one side of {name}.
point.liveSetupLaptop: Put the device facing {name}. Put a favourite toy about 1 m to one side of {name}.
point.liveSteps: Each time: put the toy on the side the screen asks for, tap that side of the picture, then say “Look!” and point at it.
point.placeLeft: Place the toy so it shows on the left of the picture, then tap the left
point.placeRight: Place the toy so it shows on the right of the picture, then tap the right
point.tapLeft: The toy is on the left
point.tapRight: The toy is on the right
point.sayLookHow: And point at the toy. Then stay still and see what {name} does.

copy.title: Copy me
copy.subtitle: We’ll see whether {name} copies simple moves.
copy.onScreenHow: The character shows four moves, then it’s {name}’s turn.
copy.liveHow: You show the moves beside the device, after a 3-2-1 countdown.
copy.setup: Stand the device on a table. {name} sits or stands 1.2–1.5 m away, so head, shoulders and both hands are in the picture.
copy.bodyOk: We can see {name}’s shoulders and hands
copy.bodyFix: Get {name}’s head, shoulders and hands into the picture — move a little further back

look.title: Look and watch
look.subtitle: A 40-second video — we’ll see which side {name} watches more.
